experiments.scope: Deterministic replay of one fixed public 128-byte message pair on the complete sha256-r31-prefix-v1 target. The same pair is returned for every organizer trial; duplicate rows are expected and are not independent attack samples.
experiments.hypothesis: The two fixed messages are distinct and have identical full 256-bit digests under standard-IV SHA-256 with rounds 0 through 30, feed-forward, and FIPS padding on every block.
